name: dark
notes: First seven categorical colors are published Okabe-Ito hexes. The eighth is #FFFFFF in place of Okabe-Ito black, which would disappear on this background. Sequential is the light end of ColorBrewer Blues so the high end stays visible. Diverging drops the two darkest RdBu ends for the same reason.
font: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
